title: 第十五章 越级安抚第十六章 斑驳的痕迹
slug: 入梦撩拨我成了兽校顶级万人迷
content_zh:
莉莎站在她面前，居高临下地看着她，眼底是压不住的怒火。
“我问你，你到底用了什么手段？”
莉莎几乎是咬着后槽牙问出来的。
月翎歪了歪头，语气轻飘飘的：“什么手段？”
“别装傻。”
莉莎往前逼了一步，“教导员为什么不惩罚你？”
月翎没起身，甚至还双手抱在胸前，微微仰起头，“你说呢？”
语调懒洋洋的，像是在说今天天气不错。
莉莎的表情变了又变。
她家世不低，容貌又出众，在班级里一直都被雄性们围着转。
可这几天，一切都变了。
原本那些献殷勤的目光，那些争先恐后的讨好，开始转向月翎。
雄性们竟然为了争夺月翎的喜爱不顾体面，厮打起来。
即便这样，教导员都没惩罚月翎，难道……
她盯着月翎那张脸，心里像堵了团棉花。
她无法将自己一直以来都瞧不上的穷酸雌性和贵族小姐联系起来。
月翎见她脸色变来变去就是不吭声，睨她一眼，语调不客气起来，“我要看书了，别挡着。”
莉莎抿紧嘴，站在原地半晌没动。
可月翎将她忽视个彻底。
她不甘心，胸口堵着一团火往外走。

刚出门，迎面撞上一个人。
“干什么？没长眼？”
罗珊被撞得生疼，抬头一看是隔壁班的莉莎，脸色立马变了。
她知道莉莎家世好，惹不起，赶紧堆起笑脸：“对不起对不起，我不是故意的……我就是想来看看我室友月翎。”
莉莎脚步一顿，“月翎？你室友？”
她眼珠转了转，上下扫了罗珊一眼，那眼神里带着审视。
罗珊被她的眼神看得发虚，只能低头。
“你跟我来。”
罗珊愣了一下，见莉莎已经转身离开，只能迈步跟上。

洛克郡学院东边的森林里，一处隐蔽的地下实验室外。
泽禹单手撑着墙壁，指节泛白。
他垂着头，双眸猩红，呼吸粗重得像拉风箱。
电子铃响了十几声，那道伪装成废弃管道的门才缓缓滑开。
content_en:
Lisa stood in front of her, looking at her condescendingly, with uncontrollable anger in her eyes.
"Let me ask you, what methods did you use?"
Lisa asked almost clenching her back molars.
Yue Ling tilted her head and said in a light tone: "What method?"
"Don't act stupid."
Lisa took a step forward, "Why doesn't the instructor punish you?"
Yue Ling didn't stand up, she even folded her hands on her chest and raised her head slightly, "What do you think?"
His tone was lazy, as if he was saying that the weather was nice today.
Lisa's expression changed again and again.
Her family background is not low, her appearance is outstanding, and she is always surrounded by males in the class.
But these days, everything has changed.
Those attentive eyes, those eager to please, began to turn towards Yue Ling.
The males even started fighting regardless of their dignity in order to compete for Yue Ling's affection.
Even so, the instructor didn't punish Yue Ling. Could it be...
She stared at Yue Ling's face, feeling like a ball of cotton was stuck in her heart.
She couldn't connect the poor female and the noble lady that she had always looked down upon.
Yue Ling saw her expression changing but remained silent. He glanced at her and said in a rude tone, "I'm going to read a book, don't block it."
Lisa pursed her lips and stood there without moving for a long time.
But Yueling completely ignored her.
She was unwilling to give in and walked out with a fire in her chest.
As soon as I went out, I bumped into someone.
"What are you doing? You don't have eyes?"
Luo Shan was hurt by the collision. When she looked up and saw Lisa from the next class, her expression changed immediately.
She knew that Lisa had a good family background and could not be offended, so she quickly put on a smile: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I didn't mean it... I just wanted to come and see my roommate Yue Ling."
Lisa paused, "Yue Ling? Your roommate?"
She rolled her eyes and glanced up and down at Roxanne, her eyes filled with scrutiny.
Luo Shan was so weak by her eyes that she could only lower her head.
"You come with me."
Roxanne was stunned for a moment, seeing that Lisa had turned around and left, so she could only step forward to follow her.

In the forest east of Rock County College, outside a hidden underground laboratory.
Ze Yu supported the wall with one hand, his knuckles turning white.
He lowered his head, his eyes were scarlet, and his breathing was as heavy as a bellows.
The electronic bell rang a dozen times, and the door disguised as an abandoned pipe slowly slid open.
